latestVersion.changelog:
Version 3.1.3

- Adds support for MPP (Machine Payment Protocol) alongside x402; now detects protocol type from response headers and routes accordingly.
- New protocol playbooks: `protocols/mpp.md` (MPP) and `protocols/x402.md` (x402) have been added to document and drive full-flow handling.
- Expanded trigger word lists (English/Chinese) and critical sensitivity rules for accurate skill activation and correct routing, especially for MPP session operations.
- Major refactor: this skill now acts as a dispatcher for HTTP 402 payment protocols, returning a ready-to-paste authorization header and covering both charge (one-shot) and session-based (open, voucher, topUp, close) MPP flows, as well as x402 v1/v2 flows.
